name: Dosbox-staging
tagline: A modern continuation of DOSBox a free and open-source emulator that enables the execution of MS-DOS software, especially video games.
description: DOSBox Staging is a modern continuation of DOSBox a free and open-source emulator that enables the execution of MS-DOS software, especially video games.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/dosbox-staging:0.83.0@sha256:e3846c5d036f8d26e3cf73137a0469f923561980e5a8c4f7f22c17306d1c9288
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
